subject: QTL mapping using physical marker locations and CP genotypes

messages.author: 80f4b3c436c3127d
messages.subject: QTL mapping using physical marker locations and CP genotypes
parts:
I have my genotypes in the CP population type (<llxlm>, <nnxnp>, etc., a JoinMap format) and only physical locations for all my markers. I figured I would have to make a genetic map using est.map, but I'm not sure how to convert my genotypes into a usable format for R/qtl. Is there a way read.cross can handle this or another way to read these data and make a map?

Thank you,
CJ

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] QTL mapping using physical marker locations and CP genotypes
parts:
read.cross with format="mapqtl" may work for you, but our ability to handle JoinMap data is not very general. Have you tried estimating the genetic map in JoinMap?

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] QTL mapping using physical marker locations and CP genotypes
parts:
Although the data were originally formatted for JoinMap, I do not have the JoinMap program, so I was hoping to do everything in R/qtl. I don't have the separate .loc and .map files like the mapqtl format requires, but do you think I could use the physical locations and create ".map-like" file? Alternatively, do you know of a way to convert the CP genotypes so I can use a more general format like "csv" for read.cross?

Thanks,
CJ
